scripts.start: npm run prestart && npx cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first EXPO_NO_CACHE=1 npx expo start --lan --clear
scripts.start:lan: npm run prestart && npx cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first EXPO_NO_CACHE=1 npx expo start --lan --clear
scripts.start:usb: adb reverse tcp:3002 tcp:3002 && npx cross-env EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3002/api EXPO_PUBLIC_SOCKET_URL=http://localhost:3002/chat NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first EXPO_NO_CACHE=1 npx expo start --lan --clear
scripts.start:tunnel: npx cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first EXPO_NO_CACHE=1 npx expo start --tunnel --clear
scripts.android: npm run prestart && npx cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first EXPO_NO_CACHE=1 npx expo start --android --lan
scripts.ios: npm run prestart && npx cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first EXPO_NO_CACHE=1 npx expo start --ios --lan
scripts.web: npm run prestart && npx cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first EXPO_NO_CACHE=1 npx expo start --web
